\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 188-190 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R193-first-pass-words-from-chapters-188-190}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a coach and a carpenter.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a thorn, a lotus, jasmine, a neem tree, a coconut palm
  \item glue, a candle, a website, an app, a screen
  \item an idea, a matchbox, a clay pot, a grinding stone, a tank
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A thorn? (\textbf{\ta{முள்}}, \emph{muḷ}.) A lotus? (\textbf{\ta{தாமரை}}, \emph{tāmarai}.) Jasmine? (\textbf{\ta{மல்லிகை}}, \emph{mallikai}.) A neem tree? (\textbf{\ta{வேப்பமரம்}}, \emph{vēppamaram}.) A coconut palm? (\textbf{\ta{தென்னைமரம்}}, \emph{teṉṉaimaram}.) Glue? (\textbf{\ta{பசை}}, \emph{pacai}.) A candle? (\textbf{\ta{மெழுகுவர்த்தி}}, \emph{meḻukuvartti}.) A website? (\textbf{\ta{இணையதளம்}}, \emph{iṇaiyataḷam}.) An app? (\textbf{\ta{செயலி}}, \emph{ceyali}.) A screen? (\textbf{\ta{திரை}}, \emph{tirai}.) An idea? (\textbf{\ta{யோசனை}}, \emph{yōcaṉai}.) A matchbox? (\textbf{\ta{தீப்பெட்டி}}, \emph{tīppeṭṭi}.) A clay pot? (\textbf{\ta{பானை}}, \emph{pāṉai}.) A grinding stone? (\textbf{\ta{அம்மி}}, \emph{ammi}.) A tank? (\textbf{\ta{தொட்டி}}, \emph{toṭṭi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 191-193 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R193-second-pass-words-from-chapters-191-193}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a shopkeeper and a customer.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a shopkeeper, a customer, a cashier, a tailor, small change
  \item a police officer, a driver, a postman, a trader, a colleague
  \item a spectator, an actor, a singer, a coach, a carpenter
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A shopkeeper? (\textbf{\ta{கடைக்காரர்}}, \emph{kaṭaikkārar}.) A customer? (\textbf{\ta{வாடிக்கையாளர்}}, \emph{vāṭikkaiyāḷar}.) A cashier? (\textbf{\ta{காசாளர்}}, \emph{kācāḷar}.) A tailor? (\textbf{\ta{தையல்காரர்}}, \emph{taiyalkārar}.) Small change? (\textbf{\ta{சில்லறை}}, \emph{cillaṟai}.) A police officer? (\textbf{\ta{காவலர்}}, \emph{kāvalar}.) A driver? (\textbf{\ta{ஓட்டுநர்}}, \emph{ōṭṭunar}.) A postman? (\textbf{\ta{தபால்காரர்}}, \emph{tapālkārar}.) A trader? (\textbf{\ta{வியாபாரி}}, \emph{viyāpāri}.) A colleague? (\textbf{\ta{சக} \ta{ஊழியர்}}, \emph{caka ūḻiyar}.) A spectator? (\textbf{\ta{பார்வையாளர்}}, \emph{pārvaiyāḷar}.) An actor? (\textbf{\ta{நடிகர்}}, \emph{naṭikar}.) A singer? (\textbf{\ta{பாடகர்}}, \emph{pāṭakar}.) A coach? (\textbf{\ta{பயிற்சியாளர்}}, \emph{payiṟciyāḷar}.) A carpenter? (\textbf{\ta{தச்சர்}}, \emph{taccar}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
